blocks.text: Sponsors give us money, parts, expertise and industry contacts. That support is what turns a design on paper into an aircraft that flies.
Sponsoring Quatlas puts your company in front of students, faculty, industry and media, and helps train the next group of engineers.
Supply the components and materials we build with. Better parts make a stronger, safer aircraft, and your company gets seen by everyone who follows the team.
Money pays for materials, new equipment and travel to competitions. Your brand is seen alongside the team wherever it competes.
Offer engineering advice, technical training, logistics or travel support. Help from people in industry makes the aircraft better and gets the team to competitions.
Back the team through crowdfunding. Every contribution goes into building and flying the next aircraft.
